$comment: SKYCOT brand colours. Three variants of one mascot: day (06:00-ish local civil dawn to dusk), dusk (local civil dusk to dawn), minimal (one-colour, small sizes, grown-up contexts). The app UI keeps #0071E3 for buttons and links in every variant.

accent.use: App buttons, links, focus rings. Never changes with day/dusk.

accentDarkMode.use: Accent on dark UI surfaces (minimal dark icon).

ink.use: Mascot outline, face, wordmark on light backgrounds

cheek.use: Mascot cheeks (90% opacity on the cloud = #FFBBAB solid)

skycotBlue.use: Bottom of the icon sky; brand blue

workshopCream.use: Warm page background, bottom of social skies

bellyShade.use: Soft shade at the bottom of the cloud body

midnight.use: Top of the dusk sky; dark surfaces

indigo.use: Dusk sky middle; dusk accent on light pages

horizon.use: Warm horizon at the bottom of the dusk sky

glow.use: Horizon glow; accent text on dusk ('AI developer.')

moonCream.use: Text and wordmark on dusk surfaces (instead of white)

lilacMark.use: Motion marks / Zz on dusk poses

bellyShade.use: Soft shade at the bottom of the cloud body (dusk)

skycotBlue.use: Minimal mark on light; minimal icon background

black.use: One-colour print, menu-bar template, Safari mask icon

timeOfDayRule.dusk: Switch to the dusk variant at local civil dusk (sun 6 degrees below the horizon, evening).
timeOfDayRule.day: Switch back to the day variant at local civil dawn (sun 6 degrees below the horizon, morning).
timeOfDayRule.fallback: If location is unknown, use the device time zone's representative city; if that fails, 18:30-06:30 local time.
timeOfDayRule.notAffected: UI accent #0071E3, the minimal mark, the grown-up wordmark, legal/invoice documents.
